numeric.name: driver_age
numeric.description: Age of the primary driver in years; a fundamental risk factor capturing young/inexperienced and elderly driver risk profiles.

numeric.name: vehicle_age
numeric.description: Age of the insured vehicle in years; older vehicles typically have lower values but higher mechanical failure risk and different repair cost profiles.
numeric.data_quality_note: Max of 68 years is plausible for classic/vintage vehicles but worth validating against vehicle_value.

numeric.name: age_driving_licence
numeric.description: Number of years the driver has held a licence; proxy for driving experience, inversely correlated with risk for younger cohorts.
numeric.data_quality_note: Min of 0 may indicate newly licensed drivers; check for logical consistency with driver_age (licence age should not exceed driver_age minus ~16).

numeric.name: vehicle_value
numeric.description: Market or insured value of the vehicle in currency units; key driver of own-damage premium components and total premium level.
numeric.data_quality_note: 0.14% nulls require imputation; max of ~374k suggests high-value outliers — consider log-transform or capping for model stability.

numeric.name: power_to_weight_ratio
numeric.description: Engine power relative to vehicle weight; indicator of vehicle performance and associated driving risk.
numeric.data_quality_note: Min of 0 may indicate data entry errors or electric vehicles with missing engine data — investigate zero values.

numeric.name: seats
numeric.description: Number of seats in the vehicle; proxy for vehicle category (passenger car vs. minibus) and occupant exposure.

numeric.name: liability_exposure
numeric.description: Fractional exposure period for liability coverage; captures partial-year policies and is a key offset/weight variable for liability sub-models.
numeric.data_quality_note: Min of 0.0027 is very small — verify these are not data errors; may represent very short-term policies.

categorical.name: policy_type
categorical.description: Type of motor insurance policy (e.g., comprehensive, third-party); directly determines which coverages are included and is the primary driver of premium level.
categorical.data_quality_note: Only 5 categories with clear coverage hierarchy; COMP_E and COMP_N may need actuarial validation of risk ordering relative to CC.

categorical.name: business_type
categorical.description: Indicates whether the policy is new business (NB) or a renewal/portfolio transfer (P); renewals may exhibit different risk profiles due to selection effects.

categorical.name: payment_frequency
categorical.description: Frequency of premium payment (Annual, Semi-annual, Quarterly); may correlate with customer segment and lapse risk, and can affect earned premium calculations.

categorical.name: bonus_score
categorical.description: Bonus-malus or no-claims discount score (Good, Neutral, Bad); reflects historical claims experience and is a strong predictor of future risk.
categorical.data_quality_note: Highly skewed toward G (341k vs 7.8k N and 4.7k B); Bad and Neutral categories have limited volume — monitor credibility.

categorical.name: fuel_type
categorical.description: Type of fuel used by the vehicle (Diesel or Gasoline); associated with vehicle usage patterns, mileage, and repair cost differences.
categorical.data_quality_note: 0.36% nulls — impute with mode or a separate 'Unknown' category; relatively minor missingness.

categorical.name: vehicle_brand
categorical.description: Manufacturer brand of the insured vehicle; captures brand-level differences in repair costs, parts availability, theft attractiveness, and driver demographics.
categorical.data_quality_note: 68 unique brands with long tail of low-volume brands; grouping recommended to avoid overfitting on sparse brands.

categorical.name: municipality_type
categorical.description: Classification of the municipality where the vehicle is registered (e.g., Intermediate, Capital, Island); captures urban/rural density and infrastructure risk differences.

categorical.name: circulation_area
categorical.description: Indicates whether the vehicle primarily circulates in Urban or Rural areas; urban areas typically exhibit higher frequency of minor accidents and theft.
